$comment: The brand's visual constants, stated once. See tokens/README.md for why this lives in contracts/ and what may go in it.

accent.role: The accent. Active tool in the Kad sketcher, selected row in oneScope, focus ring in libControl, PWA theme_color in SAMPLE and PLAY, bar fill in generated timeline JSON.

accentTint.role: Hover wash for menu rows on dark panels. The accent at 18% over a dark ground.

onAccent.role: Text and icons sitting on an accent fill.
